9c44f7c6.text: It slipped into the wide, quiet river, and the river carried it along, slow as a sigh, past sleeping willows and silver stones.

df3e9aca.text: It burst into the river with a splash, and the ducks cheered, and the sun peeked out to see!

af312855.text: It sailed proudly into the river, where a duck mistook it for a sandwich, tasted it, and decided it needed more salt.

f900614a.text: It reached the river. The water went still. Something underneath moved first.

2b3fa3cd.text: It drifted into the river, so small among the dark waves, until even the girl who made it couldn't see it anymore.

d938e990.text: Crash! Splash! Bang! The river slammed it everywhere!
